children.value: The IO table and greenhouse gas data behind each of the 148 countries in the model, with the year of each.
Planned for v1.0: a filterable table with a clickable map, and per-country details on trade reconciliation, accounting basis, currency and price index, and benchmarked sectors.
sets which kind of IO table and emissions data it starts from. See

All IO tables are converted to 2024 U.S. dollars. Emissions stay at their data year, so a country’s direct emission intensities are its data-year emissions per 2024 dollar of output. Tier 3 countries are the exception: their intensities are 2018 emissions per 2018 dollar (see

Tier 3 countries share one IO template, a blend of Malaysia (30%) and Tunisia (40%) from the ICIO for 2020 and Mexico (30%) from FIGARO for 2023; the table gives 2020, the year of most of the blend. They also share one GHG template, scaled to each country’s fossil CO₂ total from
The rest-of-world region is not in the table. Its input recipe and emission intensities are pooled from Colombia, Mexico, Türkiye, and Chile.
